description: This file defines a PHP class named Mem for caching operations using Memcache. It provides methods for connecting to Memcache, retrieving, setting, and deleting cache entries, encapsulating Memcache interactions within a class in the Opencart\System\\Library\\Cache namespace.

classes.name: Mem
classes.description: A class providing a wrapper around PHP's Memcache extension for caching operations with methods for connecting, retrieving, storing, and deleting cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache connection with specified expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.
